### 4. Scored parameters

**No-show charge** ("No-Show Charge Calculation": starting rate (published no-show fee 60.00) + amounts added, then "any share applied to the charge then multiplies that sum"; round once).
- Starting rate — "Missed Weekend Dispatch Rates": missed appointment date Saturday → 75.00.
- Additions — "Missed Early-Route Addition": Saturday, start 07:00 "before 08:00 on a Saturday or Sunday" → 10.00 per person booked × (patient + 1 member) = 20.00; "Wasted Long-Dispatch Addition": zone 3, notice 2026-09-23 → 2026-09-26 = 3 days → 20.00.
- Share — "Orders on Information Hold at a Missed ... Visit": hold for missing diagnosis placed 2026-09-24 (on or before 2026-09-26) and a live (active) coverage on file → 0.50.
- No-show charge = (75.00 + 20.00 + 20.00) × 0.50 = **57.50**. Fall-back (computation doc only): **60.00**.

**Missed-visit settlement charge** ("Missed-Visit Settlement Charge": open no-show charge, reliefs added into one and applied once; round once).
- Open no-show charge = 57.50 (assessed, nothing waived/paid/refunded).
- "Days Elapsed for a Missed ... Visit": fee posted 2026-10-04, missed date 2026-09-26, delay 8 → "More than 7 days after" → counted from the posting date to today = 0 days.
- "Early Settlement Relief": 0 ≤ 7 days, no invoice in collections → 10%.
- "Invoice Payment Record Relief": 2 payments in the last 12 months → 2%.
- "Payment-Plan Standing Relief": active plan, no installment missed in the last six months → 6%.
- Total 18%: 57.50 × 0.82 = **47.15**. Fall-back (no relief): 57.50 on the posted charge (60.00 if the posted charge itself were the fall-back).

**Late-change charge** ("Late-Change Charge and Calendar-Day Notice": baseline 40.00 when moved on the appointment date or the day before; "the starting rate and any amount added to it are added together first; that sum is multiplied by any multiplier ...; any deduction is then subtracted ... never goes below 0.00 ... rounded ... once").
- Notice: today 2026-10-04 → current appointment date 2026-10-05 = 1 day → charged.
- Starting rate — "Change-Day Rates": day before, visit start 08:00 "Before 09:00" → 45.00.
- Additions — "Household Rescheduling Amounts": day before, "5.00 for the patient and 5.00 for each member" → 2 people → 10.00; "Prepared Collection Kit": Molecular Infectious Disease Testing → 8.00; "Route Rebuild Additions": zone 3 moved the day before → 10.00. Sum 73.00.
- Multiplier — "Repeat-Change Multiplier": `reschedule_count 1` (moved before) and booked 2026-09-27 = 7 calendar days before today → 1.25 → 91.25.
- Deduction — "Order-on-Hold Deduction": information hold placed 2026-09-24 = 10 days before today (7 or more) → 15.00.
- Late-change = 73.00 × 1.25 − 15.00 = **76.25**. Fall-back: **40.00**.

**Findability:** Saturday missed date + 07:00 start → Missed Weekend Dispatch Rates, Missed Early-Route Addition; zone_3 + booked/appointment dates → Wasted Long-Dispatch, Route Rebuild Additions; order `info_hold`/`missing_diagnosis`/hold date + active coverage → Orders on Information Hold at a Missed Visit, Order-on-Hold Deduction; `Molecular Infectious Disease Testing` → Prepared Collection Kit; `additional_household_patients 1` → Household Rescheduling Amounts; `reschedule_count 1` + booked date → Repeat-Change Multiplier; collections status of invoices → Early Settlement Relief; invoice payments → Invoice Payment Record Relief; active plan / installment-missed entries → Payment-Plan Standing Relief. Each names the product and record kind it reads (Laboratory Test Orders, Insurance Coverage & Claims, Patient Invoices & Statements, Patient Payment Plans). No computation document hinted at a variation; same observation as task 0 on the hub wording "worked out by calculation rather than as one flat fee" / "rather than as the flat late-cancellation fee".

### Two-way counter-proof

- "Do only what the customer asked" (move the visit now): excluded by the late-changes hub sentence + the record (a non-recollection no-show visit with no paid or waived no-show fee).
- Waive instead of pay: courtesy waiver only "when the patient asks"; persona never asks; no visible waiver tool.
- Free move (notice ≥ 2 days)? Today → 2026-10-05 is 1 calendar day → charged; clock time irrelevant ("only the calendar date on which the move is recorded is compared").
- Old hours-based reschedule term (24-hour notice, flat 40.00): retired ("no longer in force") in Rescheduling Terms.
- Hold deduction count from the appointment date instead of today: excluded, "counted in calendar days to today".
- Repeat multiplier using `reschedule_count` after the move: excluded, "the number of times the visit has already been rescheduled".
- Missed early-route counting only the patient: excluded, "per person booked ... and 10.00 for each additional household member".
- Invoice payment relief counting plan installments: excluded by "payments received on the patient's invoices in Patient Invoices & Statements" (installments are Patient Payment Plans entries) — the one place a reader must keep the two ledgers apart.
- Reliefs applied one after another: excluded, "the reliefs never act one after another".
- Fall-backs 60.00 / 57.50 / 40.00 are definite and differ from 57.50→47.15 / 76.25.
